name: How long does a kitchen expansion remodel take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen expansion remodel take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen expansion remodel can vary widely, but typically ranges from 3 to 6 months once construction begins. This timeline does not include the initial design and permitting phases, which can add another 1 to 3 months, especially in jurisdictions like Daly City or San Mateo where permit review times can be extensive. Factors influencing the timeline include the project's complexity, material lead times, and the efficiency of the permitting process. A detailed project schedule will be provided by your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen expansion typically takes 3-6 months for construction, plus 1-3 months for design and permitting, depending on complexity and local regulations.
